one_pagers.headline: Advent has 3 direct precedents in Behavioral Health and Healthcare Services, including a 2024 deal at $303.9M
one_pagers.overview: Advent International is a financial sponsor with 18 deals in the data, 15 closed, from 2016 to 2024 (F1, F3). Deal size runs from $13.5M (MA-2016-0302) to $5,536.6M (MA-2016-0231), with a median of $124.0M (F13). It has bought in Behavioral Health (3 deals), Dental (3), Health Insurance (3), Revenue Cycle (3) and Medical Devices (2) (F4-F8). It did 3 deals in 2023-2024, and the last was in 2024 Q4 (F15).
one_pagers.fit_thesis: The target's $200.0M EV is larger than 61% of Advent's deals, so it sits inside the range it usually buys in (F14). Advent has 3 direct precedents against a peer median of 2 (F19, F30). Its Behavioral Health count of 3 deals, at 0.77 similarity, is the clearest adjacent-sector link (F4). It has 1 Physician Groups deal and 1 Healthcare Services deal (F9, F10). The Healthcare Services count matches the peer median of 1 (F29), so that count does not set it apart. Its 13 regional targets out of 18 (72%) are close to the peer median of 80%, so regional focus is not specific to Advent (F18, F33). Its 8 of 18 deals (44%) with margins at or above 16.8% compare with a peer median of 39% (F17, F32). Outside the data: platform versus add-on fit, exit path and holding period are not shown.
one_pagers.precedent_commentary: The three direct precedents matter most: MA-2024-0120 (Healthcare Services, $303.9M, 9.3x), MA-2021-0341 (Behavioral Health, $163.0M, 13.2x) and MA-2023-0108 (Behavioral Health, $123.0M, 14.6x). All three closed and fall in the $100.0M-$400.0M band. MA-2024-0120 is the most recent and the closest in sector. The two non-direct deals, MA-2021-0072 ($29.5M) and MA-2019-0027 ($95.1M), fall below the size band.
one_pagers.valuation_commentary: Market comps are 10 closed Healthcare Services deals with a median EV/EBITDA of 12.1x and a median EV/Revenue of 2.90x (F22). Advent's 3 direct precedents have a median EV/EBITDA of 13.2x (F20). Across its 15 closed deals, the median EV/EBITDA is 15.5x and the median EV/Revenue is 3.19x (F23). The data doesn't show what Advent would pay for this target.
one_pagers.conviction_reason: Conviction is High because Advent has 3 direct precedents, which meets the threshold of 3 or more (F19, F34). It also has 1 Healthcare Services deal (F21). The Competitive process risk is normal severity, so it does not lower the level.

one_pagers.fit_thesis: The target's $200.0M EV is larger than 78% of TPG's deals (F13). TPG has 2 direct precedents, MA-2022-0350 and MA-2021-0369 (F18). It also has 3 Physician Groups deals, 3 Behavioral Health deals and 2 Dental deals, sectors with similarity weights of 0.83, 0.77 and 0.72 (F4, F5, F7). Private targets are 11 of 18 deals (61%), against a peer median of 36% (F15, F30). That private-target share is a distinguishing trait. MA-2021-0369 is Behavioral Health, $117.9M, closed, at 8.8x and 2.33x. The other 3 deals are Physician Groups at $23.1M, $15.2M and $7.0M. They are not direct precedents because they fall below the $100.0M-$400.0M range. MA-2018-0111 is also still pending.
one_pagers.valuation_commentary: The 10 market comps show a median EV/EBITDA of 12.1x and a median EV/Revenue of 2.90x (F21). TPG's 2 direct precedents show a median EV/EBITDA of 10.0x (F19). Across its 15 closed deals, TPG's median is 15.7x EV/EBITDA and 2.43x EV/Revenue (F22). That all-deal figure covers a wide size range ($7.0M to $1,387.8M), so it is a weaker guide to this target than the direct precedents (F12).
one_pagers.conviction_reason: Conviction is Medium because TPG has 2 direct precedents, below the 3 needed for High, and 1 deal in Healthcare Services (F18, F20, F33). The one data risk is normal severity, so it does not lower the level (F34).
